name: Qdrant
description: Qdrant is a vector similarity search engine that provides a production-ready service with a convenient API to store, search, and manage points (i.e. vectors) with an additional payload.
composeYaml:
services:
  qdrant:
    image: 'qdrant/qdrant:latest'
    environment:
      - 'QDRANT__SERVICE__API_KEY=${QDRANTAPIKEY}'
    volumes:
      - 'qdrant-storage:/qdrant/storage'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - "bash -c ':> /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/6333' || exit 1"
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
